_note: EXAMPLE protocol only. Thresholds are starting points: tune against your lab SOP and the product's own reconstitution instructions before assessing students.
name: Reconstituting a vial (swirl, don't shake)

steps.title: Set up in the work zone
steps.instruction: Place the vial and diluent inside the marked zone. Keep your hands visible.

rules.message: Show your hands to the camera
Hands must stay inside the work zone

steps.title: Add the diluent
steps.instruction: Add the diluent slowly and steadily. Do not shake the vial.

rules.message: Moving too fast. Add the diluent slowly

steps.title: Swirl gently
steps.instruction: Swirl the vial in gentle circles until dissolved. Never shake.

steps.title: Set down and let it settle
steps.instruction: Put the vial down. Do not shake or tap it.

rules.message: Do not shake or tap the vial
